item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00282","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C11","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 is a concrete and material drafting source. The child expressly recalls the proposal made \"last March,\" and C22, dated March 1, 1956, contains that proposal. The child closely reproduces C22's distinctive formulation that future production of fissionable materials anywhere in the world should no longer increase explosive-weapons stockpiles. It also reuses C22's linked machinery of reciprocal aerial inspection, ground inspection, exchanged military information, international supervision, and arms reduction. C11 and C07 provide additional background and recurring language from the same correspondence, but neither matches the child's distinctive nuclear-material proposal as directly as C22.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"after a date to be agreed upon, production of fissionable materials anywhere in the world would no longer be used to increase the stockpiles of explosive weapons","parent_excerpt":"future production of fissionable materials anywhere in the world would no longer be used to increase the stockpiles of explosive weapons","explanation":"Near-verbatim reuse of a distinctive substantive proposal."},{"child_excerpt":"I agreed to your proposal for ground inspection on the assumption that you would also agree to my proposal for aerial inspection, and exchange of military information","parent_excerpt":"the adoption of my Geneva proposal combined with ground inspection teams which you proposed, thus reducing the danger of surprise attack","explanation":"Both combine Eisenhower's aerial-inspection proposal with Bulganin's ground-inspection proposal as reciprocal safeguards against surprise attack."},{"child_excerpt":"There is obvious need of international supervisory mechanisms and controls which will encourage greater reductions.","parent_excerpt":"limitations on armaments rather than on men. The former are more subject to supervision, regulation and control than the latter.","explanation":"The child carries forward C22's distinction between unilateral manpower reductions and internationally supervised limitations on armaments."}]}
